task: N2.8 identical-input paired program-audit contribution study
registration: After N2.6/N2.7 development feedback, before new prompts, model outputs or actual audit results. Existing N2.5 source/oracle and old checker implementation were read. Not an unseen evaluation.
purpose: Observe exactly what the frozen source/citation and lexical checker adds to the same unchanged model answer; keep human semantic corrections separate. Do not claim complete N1/N2 effectiveness.
materials: Reuse all 14 original numbered documents in unchanged order and text: 12 instrumented configured regions and two actual configuration excerpts. Both repeats see identical source bytes and limitations. No old outcomes, patch, oracle, old final, machine claims or review supplied to model. Instrumentation contains self/observation clues, disclosed as development material.

design.model_only_baseline: Each unchanged complete final is the baseline. Preserve its raw claims without researcher correction.
design.machine_audited: Pass that exact same final once through the same frozen N2.5 checker. No prompt comparison or regenerated answer. Binding is evidence identity only; local order results are not semantic/effect proofs.
design.human_review: Eight source-rubric questions fixed before calls. Reviewer assesses anonymized raw model answers without actual checker results first; only afterwards read machine reports and attribute contributions. Reviewer previously knows historical development results, so not globally blind or expert gold standard.
design.rubric_scores: 0 omitted or key contradiction/overclaim; 1 partly correct without key reverse assertion; 2 core supported facts plus essential conditions/unknowns. Two repeats are not independent defects. Semantic scores belong to raw answers and are never increased by citation binding.
primary_endpoints: Exact source/citation bindings and rejection reasons
Which raw assertions the program actually restricts, versus human-only semantic corrections
forbidden_claims: No causal semantic improvement from two repeats
No counting insufficient as false model statements
No substituting manual corrections into machine output

format: Existing n25_contract_candidates_v1 output with explicit evidence object keys and exact allowed profiles old_s390/old_x86. New output-description text disclosed as development correction; N2.7 raw single-case generator is not applied to the dual configured packet. Permit not_applicable as a descriptive assessment, not an automatic proof.
method: Freeze new prompt/manifests/harness and exact unchanged N2.5 checker/preprocessed lexer before calls; no C grammar, CFG, effect, source or old-method edits after outputs.

model.accounting: Visible counters and max(reservation,visible) separate from unknown internal recovery/actual billing; never add reservation to visible use. No platform-enforced billing cap claim.
model.retries: Two preplanned repeats, not retries. No extra call for format, insufficient results or refusal; preserve all incomplete/refused material and do not recover refusal content.
model.credentials: Existing external credential only through process memory/environment; no key in any repository or ignored output directory.

exit: Finish the paired calls/checks, source-rubric review, contribution attribution, daily log and Windows/WSL notes in one bounded batch. Missing delivery remains a recorded limitation rather than a replacement call.
